title: A dramatic event at the end of the Ice Age wiped out North American megafauna

tellings.quote: I guarantee you that the North Atlantic ice cap and this dramatic event that that inst I say instantly but rapidly ended the ice age. I mean it eviscerated North America.

plain: A researcher of ancient history, Luke Caverns, says a dramatic event involving the North Atlantic ice cap brought the last Ice Age to a rapid end. He says it devastated North America and wiped out its giant animals, and he mentions an unnamed evolutionary biologist in support. If true, a sudden catastrophe, not slow change, would explain the end of that era.
